english.title: Wilfully obstruct a highway with an non motor vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, wilfully obstructed the free passage along a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 137(1) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority/excuse
wilfully obstructed
the free passage along a highway

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 12th May 2022 due to a change in penalty by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022. For the offence applying before this date, see H4128.
(ii) See offence wording: H100652 - for wilful obstruction of highway with a motor vehicle, and H3850 for failing to comply with order to remove obstruction.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
